datasheet_identity.title: BZX84C2V4 THRU BZX84C75 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES (SOT-23 Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes)

extraction_notes: Multi-part datasheet BZX84C2V4-BZX84C75; BZX84C8V2 row (marking Z7): VZ 7.7/8.2/8.7 V at IZT = 5 mA; ZZT = 15 ohm max at IZT; ZZK = 80 ohm max at IZK = 1.0 mA; IR = 0.7 uA at VR = 5.0 V; typical temperature coefficient +3.2 to +6.2 mV/degC at IZTC; admissible zener current column IZM = 5 mA as printed.
PD = 300 mW, RthJA = 417 degC/W, Tj/Tstg -55 to +150 degC (p. 1 maximum ratings).

Curve digitization method: page 3 rasterized at 600 dpi; Fig.1 axes calibrated from printed gridlines (x: 1-11 V linear at 0.5 V per gridline; y: 0.5-100 mA log). The 8.2-labeled curve is the third curve from the right (left of the 9.1 and 10 curves); its x-position was measured at fixed currents by pixel run tracing with gridline columns excluded.
Digitized crosschecks: 8.22 V at IZT = 5 mA versus the 8.2 V nominal table value; incremental slope between 2 mA and 10 mA is about 9 ohm, below the 15 ohm ZZT maximum.
Points above 20 mA were not digitized because the printed PD = 300 mW limit line and the vertical part-number labels cross the curve region there.
Capacitance is null: no capacitance value is tabulated for an individual type; Fig.5 (p. 3) is a family-level typical capacitance vs nominal zener voltage plot and was not digitized.
Fig.3 temperature coefficients, Fig.4 typical leakage vs nominal VZ, and Fig.6 zener impedance vs nominal VZ are family-level plots against nominal zener voltage and were not digitized.
No reverse recovery or switching time is published.
